mentl/566ff72:
Extends $list_index to be exhaustive across all four list tags per
Hβ §1.7 + CLAUDE.md representations. Adds tag-1/3/4 constructors +
$list_to_flat materializer.

Pre-extension state:
  $list_index read the tag field but only dispatched on tag 0 (flat);
  tags 1 (snoc), 3 (concat), 4 (slice) silently fell through to flat
  access at the wrong offset, returning corrupt data. The seed worked
  in practice because lexer.wat / parser.wat / emit_*.wat all use FLAT
  lists exclusively (everything bouncing off $make_list). The shape
  was structurally incomplete, sufficient for current bootstrap surface
  but blocking any src/*.nx that exercises non-flat lists in graph
  compilation (lib/runtime/lists.nx's snoc/concat/slice arms; future
  graph.wat/env.wat overlays).

Post-extension state:
  $list_index is exhaustive — tag 0 O(1) direct; tag 1 (snoc) O(depth)
  recursive on tail with head shortcut at count-1; tag 3 (concat)
  O(depth) recursive on left/right by left's $len; tag 4 (slice)
  O(depth) recursive on base with start+i offset. Unknown tag traps
  via (unreachable) — no silent corruption.

  $list_set + $list_extend_to remain FLAT-only per the buffer-counter
  substrate (Ω.3) — load-bearing across graph/trail/overlay arrays.
  Non-flat callers materialize via $list_to_flat first.

  New constructors:
    $list_alloc_snoc(tail, head) → [count, tag=1, tail, head]
    $list_alloc_concat(left, right) → [count, tag=3, left, right]
    $list_alloc_slice(base, start, count) → [count, tag=4, base, start]
  Plus $list_tag accessor + $list_to_flat materializer (idempotent;
  returns input unchanged when already flat).

    18 files); lexer + emit unaffected (existing FLAT usage runs the
    tag-0 fast path)
